description: Sends the homeowner's name, email, phone, address and fence details to ONE GroundQuote contractor. Only call after the homeowner has explicitly agreed to share these details with that contractor. wants_site_visit=true asks the contractor to call and arrange a measurement visit; false is a price inquiry. The contractor contacts the homeowner directly; GroundQuote does not email or text the homeowner and never charges them. Repeat calls for the same homeowner and contractor within a day return the same request.

address.description: Street address of the property where the fence goes

homeowner_consent.description: Must be true: the homeowner agreed to share their contact details with this contractor

notes.description: Anything the homeowner wants the contractor to know (slope, HOA, pets, deadline)

height.description: Height, e.g. "6 ft" or 6. Optional if only one is offered.

linear_feet.description: Total fence length in feet. Ask the homeowner; it is their estimate.

remove_old_fence.description: Tear out and haul away an existing fence

style.description: Style from the contractor's catalog (e.g. "Privacy"). Optional if they offer only one.

name: send_quote_request
title: Send the homeowner's request to a contractor
